mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_agent_permission(employee_id, agent_id, status, version, granted_by_employee_id, granted_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{employeeId}, #{agentId}, 'GRANTED', 0, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'GRANTED', version = version + 1, granted_by_employee_id = #{actorId}, granted_at = #{now}, revoked_by_employee_id = NULL, revoked_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now}
